title: Right Reason, Wrong Advice: Evaluating Recourse in LLM Explanations of Denied Requests
abstract: arXiv:2611.21545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models increasingly write the explanations people receive when a rule system denies their request. If several rules deny the request independently, an explanation can name a true reason and still leave the person denied after they fix it. We call the missing property recourse validity: changing what the explanation cites, without changing what was asked for, can flip the decision. We compute it exactly, and a hitting-set argument predicts from the policy alone when a correct reason fails. In six of seven rule systems ported from access control and US benefit eligibility, a single correct reason almost never gives recourse when several reasons apply. Across 20 LLMs, checks of whether the cited reasons are correct, computed or asked of an LLM judge, are close to chance at spotting this failure, as the argument predicts. A strong judge asked whether acting on the explanation would work does spot it. Stronger and reasoning models do

translated_title: 理由正确，建议无效：评估大语言模型对被拒绝请求解释中的补救有效性
translated_abstract: 语言模型越来越多地承担了在规则系统拒绝用户请求时撰写解释的任务。如果多条规则独立地拒绝了该请求，那么解释即使指出了一个真实的原因，用户修复该原因后请求仍会被拒绝。我们将这种缺失的属性称为“补救有效性”：在不改变所请求内容的前提下，改变解释所引用的原因，就能改变决策结果。我们对这一属性进行了精确计算，并通过命中集论证，仅凭策略本身就能预测一个正确的原因何时会失效。在从访问控制和美国福利资格制度移植的七个规则系统中，有六个系统在多条原因同时适用时，单一正确的原因几乎从不提供有效的补救。在20个LLM上的实验表明，无论是通过计算还是询问LLM评判者来核查所引用原因是否正确，在发现这种失效方面都接近随机水平，正如该论证所预测的。而一个被询问“按照解释行动是否可行”的强大评判者则能够发现这种失效。更强和具备推理能力的模型表现……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“补救有效性”这一新概念，指出当多条规则独立拒绝请求时，LLM生成的解释即使引用了真实原因也无法带来有效补救，而常规的正确性检查无法发现这一缺陷，只有询问强评判者“照解释行动是否可行”才能识别该问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "recourse validity," showing that when multiple rules independently deny a request, LLM explanations can cite a true reason yet provide no effective recourse, and that standard correctness checks fail to detect this flaw, whereas a strong judge asked whether acting on the explanation would work can spot it.
